sn15.3:1.3: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ. “dīgharattaṃ vo bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ”.
sn15.3:1.4: taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave katamannu kho bahutaraṃ yaṃ vā kho iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ amanāpasampayogā manāpavippayogā kandantānaṃ rudantānaṃ assu passannaṃ paggharitaṃ, yaṃ vā catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakanti?
sn15.3:1.5: “yathā kho mayaṃ bhante, bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāma, etadeva bhante, bahutaraṃ yaṃ no iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ amanāpasampayogā manāpavippayogā kandantānaṃ rodantānaṃ assu passannaṃ paggharitaṃ, yaṃ vā catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakanti?
sn15.3:2.1: sādhu sādhu bhikkhave, sādhu kho me tumhe bhikkhave, evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha.
sn15.3:2.2: etadeva bhikkhave, bahutaraṃ yaṃ vo iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ amanāpasampayogā manāpavippayogā kandantānaṃ rudantānaṃ assu passannaṃ paggharitaṃ, na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ.
sn15.3:2.3: dīgharattaṃ vo bhikkhave, mātumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ. [etadeva bhikkhave bahutaraṃ yaṃ]
sn15.3:2.4: tesaṃ vo mātumaraṇaṃ paccanubhontānaṃ amanāpasampayogā manāpavippayogā kandantānaṃ rudantānaṃ assu passannaṃ, paggharitaṃ. na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ.
sn15.3:2.5: dīgharattaṃ vo bhikkhave pi pitumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ …pe…
sn15.3:2.12: …pe… rogavyasanaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ …pe… tesaṃ vo rogavyasanaṃ paccanubhontānaṃ amanāpasampayogā manāpavippayogā kandantānaṃ rudantānaṃ assu passannaṃ paggharitaṃ. na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ.
sn15.3:2.15: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ, alaṃ vimuccitunti.
